name: Fearsome Tattoos
body:
Benefit: A rogue with this talent has tattoos which give him a fearsome appearance. When he reveals his tattoos, they give him a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks.

Special: This talent can be taken a second time adding an additional +2 to Intimidate checks.
